Musical Instrument

You sound a familiar note and adjust the tuning until it settles.

Rules

ID: item-musical-instrument

Market price: 12 coins. Bulk: 1.

One portable ordinary instrument chosen by the owner. Enables ordinary performance, not an ability grant or social bonus.

Buying equipment grants no DP advancement, training or ability. Use normal item-handling actions unless an applicable card says otherwise.
